scenes.text: It's 1 a.m. Do you know what app your kid is on?

scenes.title: Downtime.
scenes.body: Schedule hours when **only calls and messages** work.

scenes.title: App limits by category.
scenes.body: Social and games get a **daily cap**. School apps don't.

scenes.title: Content & download rules.
scenes.body: Block explicit content and **require approval** for new apps.

scenes.title: Keep the passcode yours.
scenes.body: The settings only work if **your kid can't change them**.

scenes.title: Bonus: talk first.
scenes.body: Tell them what you're setting up and why. **It lands better than a surprise.**
